column1: # routine_multi_topic: multi-topic routine messages (mostly GREEN) plus ones with one buried YELLOW or RED finding; authored by claude-opus-5-5 per LABELLING_GUIDELINE v1.1

column5: Bit nervous about doing too much. Knee is sore after physio but it eases off within the hour. How many reps of the heel slides should I actually be doing?
Forgot my lunchtime paracetamol and took it at 4 instead, is that ok? Also when is my staple removal, nobody told me the date.
Not sleeping great because I hate lying on my back. When can I sleep on my side with the pillow between my knees? Otherwise feeling ok.
Doctor sir, kindly advise can I take calcium tablet with morning tea, missed it yesterday. Also when can I sit for puja on chair?
ankle puffs up by evening but its gone by morning when i keep it up. can i start using one crutch instead of two? and is the bike ok yet
My dad is a bit down and grumpy since coming home but still eating and chatting. He took his stool softener late tonight. Should he still take tomorrow's on time?
When can I get the wound wet in the shower, and do I need to book the 6 week x-ray myself or will the clinic send a letter?
knee stiff as anything first thing, loosens up after a walk round the house. bit frustrated with how slow the bending is. any tips to get past 90?
Three questions: can I go upstairs without the stick yet, when can I drive an automatic, and is a raised toilet seat still needed at week 5?
Took painkiller 2 hours late today because I slept off. Pain is little bit there but manageable. Also feeling tensed about staying home alone, is it normal?
Missed vitamin D tablet in the morning, can I take with dinner? Also how much protein I should take for healing, appetite is little less these days.
Knee feels tight and achy after the exercises, no calf pain at all, and the swelling goes down with ice and feet up. Am I overdoing the straight leg raises?
Need my sick note extended, who do I ask? Also my job is mostly sitting at a desk, could I go back part time at week 6?
Mother is sleeping less at night but she naps in afternoon and is cheerful. She is walking with walker in house. What diet to give for fast healing, she is pure veg.
Can I take my evening painkiller an hour earlier so it helps me sleep? The ache at night is the ordinary kind, it just keeps me awake a bit.
hi, is it ok to sit on the sofa if I add a firm cushion? also can I have a glass of wine with dinner now I'm off the strong painkillers
Feeling a bit anxious about flying home next month. Do I need a letter from the surgeon for airport security, and should I wear the stockings on the plane?
shud i take the paracetamol before physio or after? knee always aches during the bends then settles by evening
Tiny dot of old blood on the dressing, hasn't spread since yesterday. When does the district nurse come to change it, and can I shower with it on?
Motion passed today after taking the syrup. Can I stop the syrup now? Also can I eat curd at night, my mother says it is cold for the wound.
Some days I feel weepy and fed up but my partner keeps me going and I do the exercises anyway. Is it ok to skip one session if I'm tired?
Walking with a cane outdoors now, knee a bit stiff on kerbs. When is it sensible to try driving? Car is a manual and it was my left knee.
Bruising on the thigh is going yellow now and the swelling is less than last week. Am I still meant to take the iron tablets after this pack runs out?
cant get comfy at nite on my back, sleep is rubbish. can i use a wedge pillow? and when can i put my own socks on without the gadget
Took the stool softener late last night by mistake, bowels are fine and regular. Do I take it at the usual time today? Also how much water should I drink?
Physio says I'm at 100 degrees of bend. When is my next review with the surgeon and should I bring the exercise diary? Still a bit tight straightening fully.
Papa is getting irritated being at home all day. He took evening tablets at 10 instead of 8 (paracetamol and gas tablet). He is using the stick properly. Any problem?
I'm self employed and stressed about money. Realistically when can I get back to light desk work, and could I work from home sooner than that?
There's a soft click when I bend the knee, no pain with it. Is that normal? Also can I add a step-up exercise yet?
I'm diabetic, what snacks are good for healing? Does it matter if the paracetamol goes before or after food? Feeling a bit flat, too much time on my hands.
Is it fine to carry a cup of tea with the walker or should I get a trolley? And how far can I bend to pick things off the floor, I use the grabber.
Temp was 37.3 this evening, only checked because my husband insisted. Leg is aching the normal amount and I'm sleeping ok. Just tell me that's fine.
Can I get my staples out at the GP practice near my daughter's house instead? And when am I allowed to soak in a bath?
When I can sit cross legged on floor for eating? Knee is bending little bit only, physio told to keep trying. Also Western toilet is compulsory?
Is it ok to take a sleeping aid with my usual paracetamol? My mind races at night but I'm coping fine during the day.
Feeling more positive this week. Swelling around the ankle is down in the mornings, exercises getting easier. Just wanted to check in before Monday's physio.
wen can i get in n out of the car normally, front seat pushed back? also clinic letter says 6 wk check but i havent had a time yet
How long do I keep injecting the blood thinner? I've done 20 and haven't missed any. Can I start driving once the injections are finished?
Kneeling still feels strange, tight across the front. Is it bad for the new knee? I'm also wondering when I can leave the crutches at home for short trips.
Writing for my grandmother. She's eating small portions but regularly, a bit tearful in the evenings, otherwise settled. Is there a dietitian at the follow up clinic we can ask?
Sir I took the pain tablet after breakfast instead of before, slight pain only when walking, it is going after rest. Should I continue same timing?
Is the stationary bike better than walking for the knee? Ankle swells a bit after a long walk but next morning it's normal. Can I garden on a kneeling pad?
Wound is dry and closed, no redness or leaking. Can I put moisturiser on the scar now? And is it fine to take ibuprofen alongside paracetamol for the ache?
My wife and I are wondering when intimacy is safe after a hip replacement and which positions to avoid. Bit embarrassed asking. Sleeping fine now by the way.
forgot multivit n the iron yday, took them today. eating ok, sleep so so but better than last wk. thats all just updating
Going back to work in a shop at week 8, standing most of the day. Should I take a stick with me? And should I ask physio for a return to work plan?
Knee is jam in the morning, after 10-15 min walking it opens. I am worrying it will not bend fully ever. How much time it takes normally?
I'm still on tramadol at night. Can I have it if I want to drive the next morning, or should I stop it first? Days are only paracetamol now.
week 3 update: swelling down most mornings, sleeping 5-6 hours, walking to the end of the road with the frame. feeling more like myself
Can I sit on a normal dining chair for meals or do I still need the high one? Also trying to lose a bit of weight to protect the new hip, any advice?
Hi, my husband had a rough night with ordinary aching and didn't take his paracetamol till 3am. Is it safe to give the next dose at 9? He's otherwise in good spirits.
Knee makes a little clicking noise on stairs, no pain, no giving way. My mind keeps imagining it's come loose though. Is clicking common with the plastic insert?
My painkiller prescription runs out Friday, do I get more from the GP or the hospital? I've been taking them a bit later each day as I need less.
Can I travel by train to my native place after 4 weeks? Will need to climb steps with walker. Also dressing change can be done at local clinic there?
I've been comfort eating out of boredom and feeling guilty about it. Would a short walk after meals count as exercise or do I stick to the physio sheet?
Should I ice before or after the exercises? Knee is sore afterwards for about an hour, the regular painkillers handle it fine.
is it ok to go to my sons wedding at 5 wks? worried abt sitting long and dancing lol. also i never sleep the night before anything so expect a rough night
Small bruise where I do the injections in my tummy, nothing else. Took tonight's injection on time. Do I bring the sharps bin to the clinic appointment?
Feeling a bit trapped with all the hip rules. When do the precautions usually relax, and can I swap the frame for crutches in the house?
Taking haldi doodh at night for healing, is it ok with the medicines? Calcium tablet I missed on Sunday. Sleep is coming better now.
My knee still looks bigger than the other one, but it goes down overnight. Can I go back to my bowls club to watch, standing with a stick?
Is it ok to have my dental cleaning next week or do I need antibiotics first? And do I keep the paracetamol going on the appointment day?
Honestly fed up today. Sore after physio like usual and it calmed down after a nap. Just needed to vent, I'll keep going with the reps.
Thermometer says 99.1F. Is that normal after an op? Also can I start my morning walks to the park again, and should I take a protein shake?
hip a bit stiff getting up from the chair, eases once im moving. ok to use the walker less indoors? still doing no crossing legs
My father wants to go back to shop from next week, only sitting at counter. Is it allowed? Also we gave his morning tablets late at 11 because of the blood test.
Missing my grandkids and feeling isolated. Is it safe to have the little ones visit and sit next to me, or will they knock the leg?
Should I push through the stretch when the knee feels tight, or stop? Also when can I go down stairs foot over foot instead of one at a time?
Bowels opened this morning, they were a bit slow on the codeine. Should I keep the lactulose daily or only when I need it? Eating prunes too.
Can I postpone my 2 week check by few days, there is a function in family. Also cinema hall 2 hours sitting is ok? Looking forward to going out.
Doctor, when I can use Indian toilet again? Hip is little stiff in morning but okay after walking. Till then commode chair is fine?
Woke late and pushed all my tablets back 2 hours (paracetamol, omeprazole, vitamins). Do I still do the exercises this morning or shift those too? Mood's decent.
Still have the numb patch on the outer side of the scar, same as it's been since the op. Is that permanent? Physio's going well, 110 degrees now.
can i have a beer at the weekend? and when cn i go back to swimming, wound is all healed up now
Totally forgot my blood thinner injection last night, I was so wound up about physio today. Knee was fine during the exercises. Do I just do tonight's?
Motion not passed since 4 days, stomach feels heavy. I am eating papaya and took the syrup late yesterday. Also when to take calcium tablet?
The pain tablets aren't touching the knee pain anymore, it's been getting worse for 3 days. Struggling to do the exercises and I'm getting short with everyone.
Temp 37.9 tonight. Leg the usual achy after my walk. Also is it ok to sleep on the operated side yet?
Bit of clear watery fluid leaking at the bottom of the wound today, dressing damp. I'm sleeping better and follow-up is booked for Thursday. Should it be looked at sooner?
The new painkiller makes me feel sick about an hour after, threw up once yesterday. Should I take it with food? Also are protein drinks worth it?
I haven't really slept or eaten properly for 5 days now, just feel flat and can't be bothered. Knee is stiff but ok. Skipped physio twice. No thoughts of hurting myself.
bit of redness along the top of the scar, feels a lil warm. swelling round ankle goes down with legs up. still ok to do heel slides?
Hip clunks when I get up from the chair and there's a sharp twinge with it. Can I still try walking with one crutch? Keeping to the precautions.
Mummy skipped her blood thinning tablet yesterday night, she thought it was the vitamin. Today we gave on time. Next checkup is on 20th. What to do?
Two of the staples are pulling and the skin around them looks puckered. Otherwise I'm in good spirits, showering with the cover on. When do they come out?
Having fever 100.6 since evening, took Crocin. Appetite is less. Should I continue the other tablets as per timing?
Haven't had a poo since Saturday and it's Tuesday, quite bloated. Took the senna late every night. Feeling a bit miserable but managing. Anything stronger I can take?
Knee pain keeps waking me every 2 hours even with the oxycodone on time. Exhausted. Can I take the night dose earlier or add something?
Getting giddiness when standing after morning tablets, so holding walker tightly. When I can go to market for small shopping?
the ooze on the dressing is bigger than this morning, its spread to the edge. do i change it or wait for the nurse tmrw? also need more dressings
Thigh swelling has been getting a bit worse each week, though it does go down when I lie with the leg up. No calf pain. Sleeping on my back is tiring.
Slipped on the bathroom mat last night and sat down hard. Walking same as before with the frame, no new pain, but it shook me up. Should someone check me?
Around stitches there is slight redness and it is warm to touch since yesterday. Can I take bath now? Also eating more dal and paneer is good?
Was travelling back from my daughter's and missed the evening rivaroxaban, only remembered at breakfast. Paracetamol was late too. Do I double up today?
38.2 on the thermometer after lunch. Did my exercises fine this morning and sleep has been decent. Should I rest today?
Knee clunks on the step-ups and feels like it might give way for a second. Normal stiffness otherwise. Should I drop that exercise?
My mum has barely eaten for four days and isn't sleeping, just lies there and won't do her exercises. She says she's not thinking of harming herself, just very low.
Since switching painkillers I've got an itchy rash on my arms, face not swollen and breathing fine. Can I go back to the office next week? Mood is fine.
Pinkish fluid seeping through the dressing after my shower. Swelling's fine, goes down overnight. Was I wrong to shower so soon?
hip pain worse every day this week, tablets dont really help now. walking with the frame still, can move the leg ok, keeping the hip rules
After taking the antibiotic I am getting vomiting two times today. Not able to eat properly. Should I take it after food or stop?
My Fragmin injections ran out yesterday and the pharmacy can't get more till Monday, so I've missed one. Who do I call about the prescription and my appointment?
One of the steri-strips is lifting and the edge of the wound looks a bit gapey, it's dry, no pus. Knee is stiff but physio is going well.
Dad's temp is 100.2F, he's a bit sleepy after lunch but chatting normally. Should we push fluids? He's been eating well.
I've not been coping for over a week, crying a lot, not sleeping, no appetite. I don't want to hurt myself. Can I talk to someone before clinic? Also when can I drive?
Knee paining very much from yesterday, even after tablet not reducing. Swelling is same as before only. Shud I take tablet early?
No stomach pain or vomiting, just haven't opened my bowels for 3 days since starting codeine. Is a gentle walk round the garden going to help?
A numb tingly patch next to the scar has spread a bit further down this week. Foot feels normal and warm. Is it ok to keep doing the exercises? Bit anxious.
The tramadol makes me so nauseous I've been skipping lunch. I've moved the dose to bedtime to sleep through it. Walking fine with the crutches though.
Husband had a nosebleed this morning, stopped after 10 minutes. He's on apixaban, took it on time. Otherwise he's walking well and eating fine.
The skin either side of the hip wound is a little pink and puffy today. When am I allowed to sleep on my good side? And can I use the recliner?
Feeling feverish since afternoon, no thermometer at home. Not getting sleep also. Can I come for review tomorrow instead of next week?
I'm on warfarin and took a double dose by mistake this morning. Also is it true I should avoid spinach? And is my paracetamol timing still the same?
Feeling low and tired, physio was hard today. Also my calf has gone hot and hard to touch since last night. How many sets should I do tomorrow?
Took my paracetamol late again. Leg's its usual stiff. Odd thing is I get puffed just sitting here and it hurts to take a deep breath. Is that the painkillers?
Yellowish thick stuff coming out of the wound and it smells. When's my next dressing change? Also can I still shower?
Fever is 102 since morning, shivering also. Not feeling to eat anything. Took tablets late. Kindly advise.
cudnt sleep, knee swollen as usual but now my toes r cold n kinda white and i cant feel them properly. also feeling anxious generally
Knee still sore after physio and I can't sleep. Honestly some nights I think everyone would be better off without me and I've thought about how I'd do it.
Was bending to reach my slipper, felt a pop and now the leg looks shorter and turned out, can't put weight on it. Also do I still need the reacher?
Mum's temp was 38.7 an hour ago, she's been very sleepy and muddled today, and she missed her lunchtime paracetamol. She's normally sharp as anything.
Poo was black and sticky this morning, I haven't eaten beetroot or taken iron. Still on the blood thinner. Also when do I stop the omeprazole?
Leg swelling is increasing up to thigh, not going down even after keeping leg up whole night. Calf also paining. Walking with walker only. What to do?
after shower the wound has split open in the middle, i can see inside a bit. pls help. also anxious and havent slept well
Started the new antibiotic at lunch, now my lips and tongue feel swollen. Also wanted to ask when my staples are due out.
Whole lower leg is rock hard and tight, the pain is way beyond anything after physio and two doses of oxycodone haven't touched it. Should I keep exercising?
Grandad tripped in the hall and bumped his head on the door frame. He's on the blood thinner. Says he's fine, just embarrassed. Leg seems ok.
Heart racing and I can't catch my breath walking to the bathroom, which I managed fine yesterday. Is this anxiety? Also when can I drive?
Shaking chills tonight and the hip wound is redder than this morning. Temp only 37.6. Also the walker's front wheel keeps sticking.
